item.text: I’ll use the supplied Deep Research Council skill to reconcile the six records and draft a dated addendum that distinguishes the searches already run from the work still needed.

**No. The board can report a preliminary review with two included trials. The packet does not support calling it a completed systematic review.** As of 1 March 2026, the search covered MEDLINE and one reference list, one potentially eligible report remained unavailable, and one reviewer had made all screening decisions without an independent check. No protocol was registered or time-stamped before the first search. These findings describe the packet through its status date. *(access-status.md §1; search-log.csv, Q1–Q2)*

## Record flow through 1 March 2026

Six records were identified, five from MEDLINE and one from citation checking. Removing one duplicate left **five records screened**. Two were excluded at title and abstract, so three reports were sought. **Two reports were retrieved and assessed, and both trials were included.** One report remained unresolved. There were zero exclusions after full-text assessment. *(search-log.csv, Q1–Q2; screening.csv, R01–R06)*

| Record | Disposition | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| R01 | Included after full-text assessment | Adult primary-care hypertension randomized trial with refill-based adherence at 12 weeks. *(study-r01.md §2)* |
| R02 | Included after full-text assessment | Adult primary-care hypertension randomized trial with validated self-reported adherence at 24 weeks. *(study-r02.md §2)* |
| R03 | Full text sought, unavailable. Eligibility pending. | The conference abstract omits follow-up duration and a complete adherence outcome definition. The corresponding author was contacted on 2 February 2026. No response or copy had arrived by 1 March. *(abstract-r03.md §1; access-status.md §1)* |
| R04 | Duplicate removed before screening | Same DOI and article as R01. *(search-log.csv, Q2; screening.csv, R04)* |
| R05 | Excluded at title and abstract | Diabetes sample with no separately reported hypertension subgroup. Full text was not sought. *(screening.csv, R05)* |
| R06 | Excluded at title and abstract | Four-week follow-up fell below the eight-week minimum. Full text was not sought. *(screening.csv, R06)* |

## Protocol addendum dated 22 November 2026

This addendum governs the remaining work prospectively. Retain Q1 and Q2 as preliminary searches with their original dates, wording, limits, yields and record IDs. Q1’s log says its export was retained. The packet supplies the log but does not identify the MEDLINE interface or provide the raw export for verification. Record that interface and attach the export if recovered. *(search-log.csv; access-status.md §1)*

| Search | Source and date | Exact logged search or method | Limits and yield |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 | MEDLINE, 10 Jan 2026 | `(hypertension OR high blood pressure) AND (SMS OR text message) AND (medication adherence) AND randomized` | `2018-2025; humans; English or Indonesian` · 5 records, R01, R02, R03, R05, R06 |
| Q2 | Backward citation check from R01, 12 Jan 2026 | `Checked reference list of R01 for eligible randomized trials; title and DOI lookup` | `No additional limits` · 1 record, R04 |

1. **Fix eligibility before further screening.** Include randomized trials published from 1 January 2018 through 31 December 2025 in English or Indonesian. Participants must be adults aged 18 or older with diagnosed hypertension managed in primary care. In mixed-condition studies, require separately reported hypertension results. Compare SMS medication-adherence reminders alone or added to usual care with usual care or no SMS reminder. Require a validated adherence measure or pharmacy-refill adherence at eight weeks or later. *(review-brief.md §1)*

2. **Expand and document the search.** Run a new MEDLINE search and search Embase, CENTRAL and Indonesia’s GARUDA. Use hypertension and SMS concepts with subject headings, spelling variants and Indonesian terms such as *hipertensi* and *pesan singkat*. Allow retrieval even when the title or abstract omits “medication adherence” or “randomized.” Search ClinicalTrials.gov and WHO ICTRP for linked publications, check relevant Indonesian repository and conference records, and check references and forward citations of included trials. Apply the publication window to eligible reports. For each run, save the source, interface, date, exact strategy as executed, fields, filters, result count, export and record IDs. For citation searches, identify the seed report and direction. Log unavailable sources, failed searches and dated amendments with reasons.

3. **Reconcile and screen independently.** Link each record to every source that found it. Deduplicate by DOI where available, then verify title, authors and year. Link distinct reports of the same trial under one study ID. Have two reviewers independently screen the preliminary and new records at title/abstract and full text, carrying uncertain records forward. Resolve disagreements by discussion, then by a third reviewer if needed. Save each reviewer’s decision, the resolution, retrieval status and one primary eligibility reason for every full-text exclusion. Repeat the R03 author request and check library holdings and companion publications. Log each attempt, date and response. If retrieval still fails at review closure, count R03 as an unretrieved report with eligibility unresolved. Reconcile the final record, report and study counts in a PRISMA flow diagram.

4. **Synthesize by outcome and follow-up.** A preliminary narrative synthesis is defensible. Both trials compared SMS plus usual care with usual care. R01 enrolled 240 rural primary-care adults and reported an **8 percentage-point** between-group difference in the proportion meeting a refill threshold at 12 weeks (95% CI 1 to 15). R02 enrolled 180 urban primary-care adults and reported a **0.7-point** between-group difference in mean change on the MMAS-8 at 24 weeks (95% CI 0.1 to 1.3). **A pooled effect is unjustified.** A difference in proportions meeting a threshold and a difference in mean scale change answer different questions, at different follow-up times. Neither report supplies the other endpoint. For the final synthesis, check extracted estimates and uncertainty independently, assess risk of bias by outcome, and reconsider pooling only within groups of trials with comparable populations, comparisons, outcome definitions, follow-up and effect measures. *(study-r01.md §2; study-r02.md §2)*
